title: Nightglass and black water
location: Road from Baldur’s Gate to Waterdeep
summary: Lucien dreams of black water, a man is found buried in the road, and Zelina works on a secret gift.

environments.name: Shared caravan wagon during Carlon’s interview
Losvius’s porcelain wagon during the wager
The road bends below a rise at sunset

scenes.title: The markings
scenes.description: Lucien stands in a shadowed hall before black water that leads to a bridge crowded with soldiers. A warm reflection hints at a traveller in the river.

narration.text: Lucien stood before a familiar robed figure in a chamber of polished black stone. News of someone seen near a town dissolved beneath the rush of water.
Black liquid seeped through the tiles. The chamber became a bridge crowded with soldiers, with arrows overhead and a dark river below.
In a patch of warm sunlight, Lucien caught the reflection of a traveller wearing a woollen cap.

scenes.title: The crossing lost
scenes.description: A traveller’s marked forehead appears in the river, with broken swords and graves on the near bank and soldiers fading into the haze beyond the bridge.

narration.text: The river held the traveller’s reflection in a patch of warm sunlight.
A gust lifted the woollen cap and exposed intricate markings across his forehead. “The markings! Remember the markings!”
Broken swords and forgotten graves. Voices whispered of a crossing lost. One word came through, “Dagger,” before black water swallowed him.
Lucien woke tangled in blankets. Across the wagon, Arietta asked whether he always dreamed so intensely.

scenes.title: A thread of light
scenes.description: Inside Coppercoil’s daylit wagon workshop, warm sparks light Zelina’s open palm as Coppercoil leans in. His workbench and parts rack frame the lesson, with the nightglass vial sketch in front and Arietta by the opening.

narration.text: Zelina asked Coppercoil for a lesson in magic. Her first attempt produced a thread of light and a small pop.
Under his guidance she found the pattern of the Weave. Sparks warmed her palm. “I did that,” she said.
Coppercoil could not place the magic. Soon Zelina tired, describing it as something tugging at a thread inside her.
While Arietta was occupied, Zelina showed him her sketch of a black-glass perfume vial bound with copper wire. Her mother had called the material nightglass, and she wanted to make Arietta a gift.

scenes.title: The man in the road — Carlon Amoffel
scenes.description: Carlon’s head protrudes from the road, a complex circular rune tattooed on his forehead. Coppercoil offers water while Lucien kneels nearby. Behind them, a thread of charm magic runs from Aldrik’s hand to Lord Aldor.

narration.text: The caravan stopped at a man buried up to his neck. A complex circular rune marked his forehead as an oathbreaker. Coppercoil gave him water.
Tyjit demanded they dig him out. Lord Aldor Urnpoleshurst objected to the delay. Lucien thought the marking echoed his dream and volunteered to take responsibility for the man.
Aldrik cast Friends to sway Aldor. When objections persisted, Sulesdeg rose to his full height and announced that the caravan had decided.
Coppercoil summoned Copperbear. The bear and the travellers dug Carlon Amoffel free, then caught him when his legs buckled.

scenes.title: Lucien’s first questions
scenes.description: Window light outlines Carlon and the circular rune on his forehead. Lucien listens from the shadowed side of the shared wagon. Green Imsa offers folded clothes, with Coppercoil’s fitted workbench and parts rack framing the conversation.

narration.text: Lucien gave Carlon shelter in the wagon he shared with Coppercoil, Arietta, and Zelina and asked how he had ended up buried in the road.
Carlon said he had promised to marry a woman, then backed out when he learned her family were bandits and expected him to join them.
Lucien suspected Carlon was holding something back. Green Imsa supplied a change of clothes.

scenes.title: A wagon full of porcelain
scenes.description: Porcelain crowds the rain-lit wagon. Losvius makes room for Coppercoil on the step while Aldrik, outside, sends a spectral hand to steady a tipping vase.

narration.text: Losvius invited Coppercoil out of the rain and into his wagon.
With porcelain on both sides, Coppercoil had to choose every handhold and foothold carefully.
One vase wobbled. From outside, Aldrik sent a spectral hand to catch it.

scenes.title: A wager on the cult wagons
scenes.description: Losvius, Coppercoil, and Aldrik confer between porcelain shelves inside the wagon while rain falls beyond the open doorway.

narration.text: Losvius told Coppercoil and Aldrik what he had found in Lasfelro’s wagon during Carlon’s rescue. A seven-foot wooden crate sat surrounded by dark soil.
Aldrik suspected a vampire. He still wondered whether some of the Cult of the Dragon’s wagons were decoys.
A wager persuaded Losvius to search one of the cult wagons during the next substantial fight.

scenes.title: Nightglass
scenes.description: From above, Coppercoil and Zelina’s hands frame an obsidian perfume vial and its sketch on the workbench. The copper-bound stopper and five gold pieces catch the light.

narration.text: As rain kept the caravan in place, Samardag explained that in Amn, nightglass meant obsidian.
Coppercoil lost twenty gold gambling with Radecere, then paid him another two hundred and fifty for the lucky pendant.
Behind a blanket that hid the workbench from Arietta, Coppercoil and Zelina magically mended the obsidian into a vial and secured its stopper with copper wire.
When Zelina asked how she could earn money for perfume, Coppercoil gave her five gold pieces. She accepted, visibly moved.

scenes.title: The road cries out
scenes.description: A hoof comes down on a mushroom, releasing black dust above the wet road. Aldrik, Lucien, and Coppercoil pull back while Vladefix and the guards clear a path in the distance.

narration.text: After two nights of storms, the caravan found the road carpeted with mushrooms. A hoof crushed one, and it moaned.
Other caps burst underfoot, releasing black dust and tiny cries. Aldrik, Lucien, and Coppercoil recognized little shriekers joined by a shared mycelium.
The cries swelled into unbearable grief and drove all three away from the road.
Vladefix and the guards used earplugs and spent three hours clearing a passage. The wagons moved on, but the sorrow followed the three into troubled dreams.

scenes.title: An overturned wagon
scenes.description: Aldrik rides toward Lucien and Coppercoil on the rise, pointing back over his shoulder toward hobgoblins attacking an overturned wagon. Tyjit holds the caravan while Carlon sits at the reins.

narration.text: Once the caravan was moving again, Carlon took the reins, freeing Lucien to talk about his dreams.
Late that afternoon, Aldrik rode back from scouting and pointed over his shoulder. Hobgoblins were attacking an overturned wagon ahead.
Tyjit halted the caravan and asked the party to clear the danger.
With sunset approaching, Aldrik, Coppercoil, and Lucien planned their approach. Down at the bend, the attack was already underway.
